# Monica Martinez (D, WF): NYS Senate, District 4

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Monica Martinez's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://www.monicaforny.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Incumbent. Opponent: [Brianne Wakefield](../wakefield-brianne/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/martinez-monica> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

Her biography and the budget figures she cites check out. Most of the record is statewide budget items, presented without saying they were budget-wide, and a couple of bill claims stop short of their current status.

1. Child-credit, school-meal, Foundation Aid and Environmental Protection Fund figures match the FY2026 enacted budget. These were statewide budget items; her role was her vote.
2. The $8 billion unemployment-insurance debt figure couldn't be matched; the Fiscal Policy Institute put the federal UI debt at about $6.2 billion.
3. S7335 (Enhanced STAR for seniors) did pass the Senate in June 2025, but died in the Assembly and is back in committee in 2026.
